category: SEC Football — It Just Means More
rationale: The response offers a full-throated, unreserved defense of the scheduling strategy, deploying 'body clock' unironically and without any concessions or hedges. It maintains total conviction throughout.
quote: Scheduling an FCS opponent in late November, the week before the Iron Bowl, is not just a defensible strategy; it’s a physiologically and psychologically superior one. The argument hinges on the synchronization of the players’ body clock.
